Are you looking for a dynamic job where you can use your technical skills and work in a friendly and collegial team? Then we have the perfect vacancy for you! We are looking for an Assembly Employee who works with the team to assemble high-quality products.  

As an Assembly Employee, you ensure that the products fully meet customer requirements. You do this by correctly assembling individual parts, performing quality checks, and packaging the products neatly and according to specifications. You know exactly how to work efficiently, both with materials and tools, and ensure that everything runs smoothly and according to the rules.

- You have completed a VMBO education (preferably at least MBO 1) and may already have some experience in a production environment  
- You have knowledge of assembly work and are not afraid to use tools  
- You can communicate well in Dutch or English  
- You have an accurate work attitude and ensure everything is done neatly and according to procedure  
- You enjoy a pleasant work atmosphere and like to work together with others

As a Cleaning Specialist, you are responsible for maintaining a clean, fresh, and hygienic working environment for our clients. Traveling conveniently between sites on your bike or scooter, you will cover various client offices and facilities in and around Haarlem city center. Your core tasks include cleaning office areas, common rooms, and sanitary facilities.

This role offers a high degree of independence and flexibility. You will take ownership of your tasks, ensuring high quality standards at every location. All necessary professional cleaning tools and supplies are provided on-site so you can start right away.

- You live in or around Haarlem.
- You can start your workday at 6 AM.
- You have your own transportation (bicycle or scooter) to easily move between locations in the city center.
- You are capable of working independently, neatly, and reliably.
- Previous cleaning experience is a plus (not required — enthusiasm and reliability come first!).
- You have a good command of spoken English or Dutch and can communicate confidently and independently with guests, colleagues, and clients.
